name: Pete Ricketts
stance: "Innovation plus guardrails": export controls on advanced AI chips to stay ahead of China, with consumer and child-safety guardrails — the safety angle real but secondary to competitiveness.

statements.text: Denying Beijing access to these AI chips is essential to our national security.
By limiting the number of high-end AI chips that are going to Communist China, we can maintain our compute lead and ensure that the United States, and not Communist China, leads the world on AI.

That’s why I introduced the MATCH Act. This bill ensures that Communist China and other adversaries cannot purchase key semiconductor manufacturing equipment (SME) technology from the United States or our allies.

Rounded up his AI portfolio: the SAFE Chips and MATCH Acts restricting export of advanced AI chips and semiconductor equipment, and the GUARD Act requiring age verification and AI disclosures and barring AI companions for minors.
It also means implementing commonsense guardrails to protect Americans without stifling innovation.
